sentences.en: Millions of beneficial organisms live in the human digestive tract.
sentences.zh: 人体消化道里住着数以百万计的有益微生物。

sentences.en: Your year-long stay in Germany was very beneficial, wasn't it?
sentences.zh: 你在德国一年的学习经历对你很有帮助，不是吗？

sentences.en: Ultimately, space flight will be beneficial to all mankind.
sentences.zh: 最终，太空飞行将对全人类都有益处。

senses.zh: 有利的；有帮助的；有用的
